description: This file defines a generic immutable wrapper class 'Immutable<T>' and an extension method 'AsImmutable()' for all objects, used within the Orleans framework for efficient message serialization.

classes.name: Immutable<T>
classes.description: A readonly struct that wraps a value of type T to ensure immutability, aiding serializer optimizations in Orleans.

methods.name: Immutable(T value)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps the given value into an Immutable instance.

methods.name: AsImmutable<T>(this T value)
methods.description: Extension method that wraps an object in an Immutable wrapper.
